shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && git ls-files | head -30

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; ls __agent_eval__
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue useThemeType 2>&1 | head -60; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit dist-tags --json 2>&1 | head

mkdir -p /tmp/uikit8 && cd /tmp/uikit8 && npm pack @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --silent 2>&1 | tail -2 && tar xzf gravity-ui-uikit-8.0.0.tgz && ls package/build/docs package/build/docs/guides 2>&1 | head -30; node -e "const p=require('/tmp/uikit8/package/package.json');console.log(p.peerDependencies, p.engines)"
cd /tmp/uikit8/package/build/docs && rg -n -i -C 3 "theme" guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -80; ls hooks; rg -n -i -C 3 "useTheme|Provider|setTheme" guides/theming.md hooks/*.md INDEX.md | head -120
cd /tmp/uikit8/package && sed -n 78,95p build/docs/guides/theming.md; rg -n "useTheme|useThemeValue|useThemeSettings" build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head;

npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 2>&1 | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components | rg -i "switch|segmented|text$|card" ; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Switch.md 2>/dev/null | head -60
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20; git status --short
